topStory.headline: Survey: 46% of High Schoolers Use A.I. in College Search
topStory.summary:
A new survey from EAB covering over 5,000 high school students reveals that 46% are using A.I. tools to find colleges. According to Inside Higher Ed, students are using A.I. technology to identify institutions that align with their needs, research application requirements, and discover new schools.

The survey found that 34% of students reported increased interest in certain schools due to A.I. insights, while 18% have removed colleges from their list based on A.I.-generated information. However, more than half of students react negatively to college communications they perceive as A.I.-generated.

The findings present a tension for enrollment teams: students are embracing A.I. tools for their own research while expressing skepticism about A.I.-generated content from institutions. The data suggests A.I. is influencing student decision-making in both directions, adding and removing schools from consideration lists based on A.I.-provided information.

stories.headline: Dartmouth College Implements Campus-Wide A.I. Integration
stories.summary: Dartmouth College has been implementing A.I. across its campus, according to the Boston Globe. The rapid introduction has generated debate among students and faculty about A.I.'s role in academia. While the college is not mandating A.I. use, the pace of implementation has raised questions among some community members about its impact on the school's traditional liberal arts focus and campus culture.

stories.headline: AAC&U Plans October 2026 Conference on A.I. in Higher Education
stories.summary: The American Association of Colleges and Universities is preparing for its conference on A.I. and higher education in October 2026. The event aims to provide educators with practical strategies for adopting A.I. responsibly, with sessions focusing on academic integrity, curricular transformation, and ethical implications of A.I. in academia.

stories.headline: ESCP Business School Hosts A.I. in Higher Education Summit
stories.summary: ESCP Business School is hosting an A.I. in Higher Education Summit, bringing together educators and industry leaders to discuss A.I. integration across business school curricula. According to Newswise, the summit focuses on preparing future business leaders for an A.I.-driven economy while maintaining ethical standards.

stories.headline: Coursera: 80% of Students Report A.I. Improves Academic Performance
stories.summary: A new Coursera report finds that 80% of students report A.I. has improved their academic performance. According to Stock Titan, the study highlights how learners are using A.I. tools for research assistance, writing support, and personalized study recommendations. Concerns about academic integrity persist alongside the reported performance improvements.

stories.headline: UC Irvine Launches A.I. Course for Postsecondary Instructors
stories.summary: UC Irvine is launching a ten-week course for postsecondary instructors on integrating A.I. into teaching. According to EdTech Innovation Hub, the program helps educators critically evaluate A.I. tools and create A.I.-enhanced learning resources. The course emphasizes using A.I. as an instructional scaffold rather than a shortcut.
